requirements.title: SHAPE argument restrictions
requirements.definition: SOURCE shall not be an unallocated allocatable variable, a pointer that is not associated, or an assumed-size array; optional KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.SHAPE-SOURCE-not-unallocated-allocatable: Positive source control allocates an allocatable array before SHAPE and observes its extents; source-control mutation omits allocation and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.SHAPE-SOURCE-pointer-associated: Positive source control associates a pointer with a target before SHAPE and observes its extents; source-control mutation leaves the pointer disassociated and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.SHAPE-SOURCE-not-assumed-size-array: Positive source control uses explicit-shape and assumed-rank dummies; source-control mutation applies SHAPE directly to an assumed-size dummy and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.SHAPE-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expre: Positive source control calls SHAPE with KIND=KIND(0); source-control mutations use a noninteger or nonconstant KIND expression and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: SHAPE result type, kind, and rank-one size
requirements.definition: The SHAPE result is integer; present KIND supplies the result kind, absent KIND gives default integer kind, and the result is rank one with size equal to the rank of SOURCE.

pending.SHAPE-result-integer: Assign SHAPE of a rank-two array to an integer rank-one sentinel array and assert exact extents; source-control mutation changes the receiving declaration away from integer in review only.
pending.SHAPE-result-kind-from-KIND: Guarded plan obtains a nondefault integer kind through SELECTED_INT_KIND, calls SHAPE(A,KIND=that_kind), asserts KIND of an element equals that kind, and mutates KIND to default integer kind.
pending.SHAPE-result-default-kind-absent: Call SHAPE(A) without KIND and assert KIND(SHAPE(A)(1)) equals KIND(0); companion call with KIND=KIND(0) guards the absent-KIND path.
pending.SHAPE-result-rank-one-size-source-rank: Use scalar, rank-one, and rank-two SOURCE values initialized away from default states; assert SIZE(SHAPE(scalar))==0, SIZE(SHAPE(vector))==1, and SIZE(SHAPE(matrix))==2, then mutate SOURCE rank.

requirements.title: SHAPE result values are dimension extents with assumed-size sentinel
requirements.definition: Each SHAPE result element is the corresponding SOURCE dimension extent, except that an assumed-rank dummy associated with an assumed-size array has last element -1.

pending.SHAPE-dimension-extents: Use non-unit-lower-bound B(-1:1,2:5) and assert SHAPE(B)==[3,4], plus zero-extent A(3:2,2:4) with nonvacuous companion B and assert SHAPE(A)==[0,3]; mutate one bound in each source so an extent changes.
pending.SHAPE-scalar-rank-zero-result: Use scalar SOURCE=3, supported by the description covering a scalar and p4 tying result size to SOURCE rank; assert SIZE(SHAPE(SOURCE))==0 and pair with nonempty array companion B(-1:1,2:5) whose SHAPE size is 2 to avoid vacuity.
pending.SHAPE-assumed-rank-assumed-size-last-min: Pass an assumed-size dummy through an assumed-rank dummy, assert the last SHAPE element is -1 and a leading known extent is preserved, then mutate the actual to explicit shape.
